name: Misty Morris
occupation: Former gun-store owner and small-business owner
background: Misty Morris is a Rock Springs native who ran as the Libertarian nominee for House District 48 in 2022. She lost the Nov. 8, 2022 general election to incumbent Clark Stith. Her Secretary of State general-election filing listed a Rock Springs mailing address.

In an Oct. 20, 2022 Rocket Miner race profile, Morris was identified as a former gun-store owner. In the same article she described herself as a mother, a foster parent, and a former small-business owner, and said she had watched her community both struggle and thrive.
